items.title: Ext out of an m-pseudo-coherent complex commutes with filtered colimits below degree minus m
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes Ext groups out of an m-pseudo-coherent complex against a filtered colimit of modules: in degrees below minus m the colimit of the Ext groups is the Ext group of the colimit, and in degree minus m the comparison map is injective. The proof uses the defining triangle that exhibits the complex as an extension of a bounded complex of finite free modules by a complex with vanishing cohomology above m, observes that Ext out of the second term vanishes in the relevant degrees, and deduces through the long exact sequence that Ext out of the given complex is isomorphic, respectively injective, into Ext out of the finite free complex. The remaining claim is that Ext out of a finite free complex commutes with filtered colimits, which follows by computing it with the Hom complex and using finiteness of the terms plus exactness of filtered colimits.
